lines.t: (whisper) The time is come, and I came.
(soft) I called you up for safety from pain.
The tombs gave up their sleepers. My hand passed through the ground;
Plucked each servant ripe. No child in womb can be found.
Now hush. The city wails, the streets cry out in loss and flame,
My Bride is gathered close. so indignation may come to those who remain.
Step into the chamber - shut the door, draw curtains tight;
Here is My peace, the keeping-place, the harbor in the night.
I shelter you from thunder; I wrap you in My shade -
My hand will walk the valley where the judgments must be made.
Hide with Me until it passes, hide with Me until refinement is through.
Few are called to mercy; The many must be brought through.
I go to sift the nations; I go to break their pride -
Hide with Me, My chosen one; within My house abide.
The earth yields My Saints - the whole world gives up its youth;
For three days bitter sorrows and the cries cannot be soothed.
I pass through fire and whirlwind to purge the hardened land,
So you may rise in morning bloom with cleansed and healing hands.
Angels climb the ladder, hand to hand they bear the prize;
From sky to soil I bridge the way - another harvest supplied..
Worry not of the end.
I break but I also mend.
Hide with Me until it passes; ride with be soon in My train
Once I have tread My Day of wrath, I’ll call you out again.
Thus nations learn the painful truth; all falsehoods fall away -
Then hand in hand we walk the Garden and greet a gentler Day.
[Outro ]
(whisper) I have sealed your place; keep watch, My love, keep rest.
(soft) Hide with Me this week - trust my ways are best.
Hide with Me until it passes, hide with Me until refinement is through.
Few are called to mercy; The many must be brought through.
I go to sift the nations; I go to break their pride.
Hide with Me, My chosen one; within My house abide.
